question: The difference between the cost price and the selling price of an object is ₹480. If the profit is 20% on the cost price, find the selling price of the object.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit = 20% = 1/5 → CP = 5 units, Profit = 1 unit

Given Difference (Profit) = 1 unit = ₹480

Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit = 5 + 1 = 6 units

SP = 6 units = 6 × 480

SP = 2,880

**∴ Answer = ₹2,880**
